jev-diffusion-rust-main/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "jev-diffusion"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Substrate-segmented image description via JEV + LLMs as GAN"
license = "Apache-2.0"
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/jev-diffusion"
keywords = ["jev", "diffusion", "substrate", "gan", "llm"]
categories = ["api-bindings", "text-processing"]
readme = "README.md"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1"
reqwest = { version = "0.12", features = ["json"] }
tokio = { version = "1", features = ["full"] }
anyhow = "1"

[lib]
name = "jev_diffusion"
path = "src/lib.rs"
